list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat(data-layer, api, dev-setup): implement course service foundation with config and discovery servers
Implements the complete Course microservice foundation including domain entities, data access layer, business logic, REST API, and infrastructure setup for the Mentify LMS platform.
## Entities - Add Course entity with bidirectional relationships to Module, Enrollment, Announcement and DiscussionForum. Cross-service references (teacherId, gradeId) stored as plain UUID strings per microservice boundary design. - Add Module entity with sequenceOrder, visibility controls and dateDuration. - Add Lesson entity with releaseDate and module-level content grouping. - Add LearningMaterial entity with MaterialType enum (VIDEO, PDF, IMAGE, AUDIO, PPT, DOC).
## Data Layer - Add CourseRepository with domain query methods: existsByCourseNameAndGradeId, findAllByTeacherId, findAllByGradeId and findAllByIsPublishedTrueAndIsVisibleTrue.
## API Layer - Add CourseRequest DTO with @NotBlank, @NotNull and @DecimalMin validation constraints. - Add CourseResponse DTO exposing all fields including publishedDate, numberOfStudents and audit timestamps. - Add CourseMapper with hardcoded safe defaults on creation (isPublished=false, isVisible=true, numberOfStudents=0) to prevent client override. - Add CourseService interface and CourseServiceImpl with duplicate guard using existsByCourseNameAndGradeId. Throws ResourceAlreadyExistsException on conflict. teacherId injected from authenticated principal, never from request body.
## Infrastructure - Initialise Spring Cloud Config Server for centralised externalised configuration across all microservices. - Initialise Eureka Service Discovery Server for dynamic service registration and inter-service communication without hardcoded host addresses.
Closes #3
